# de Ruyter et al. (2012): beverage substitution and body weight in children

Source: https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1203034

Randomized 18-month trial, 641 children; imputed analysis reports BMI z-score changes 0.02 vs 0.15 and weight gain 6.35 vs 7.37 kg (sugar-free minus sugar contrast); alternative measured sample less conclusive for BMI z-score. Physical health context, never pooled with behaviour.

External reference only; full-text/data redistribution rights not established. No source files are mirrored. The named research consumer is planned.
